name: Haining China Leather Market Co.,Ltd
summary: Haining China Leather Market Co.,Ltd engages in the development, leasing, and service of specialized leather market in China. The company engages in the wholesale and retail transaction of leather garments to include raw material supply, fashion business parks, factory leasing, design and R&D, fashion shows, fashion wholesale, headquarters business, exhibitions and foreign trade, e-commerce live streaming, financial services, and healthcare. It also provides property leasing, health and medical and hotel services. In addition, the company engages in the design, production, marketing, and trading of leather and garments.
